newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Banco Cisf, Finantia close Goldman bond syndicate.
newsitem.headline: Banco Cisf, Finantia close Goldman bond syndicate.

text.p: Joint leaders Banco Cisf and Banco Finantia said on Monday that the syndicate for a 10 billion escudo Navigator bond being launched by Goldman Sachs had been closed.
Senior co-leader is Banco Portugues de Investimento and co-leaders are Banco Essi and Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor. Banco Mello and Argentaria are co-managers.
The bonds are being issued at par with a coupon of six month Lisbor plus 20 basis points. --Lisbon bureau 3511-3150035
